free_parameters.name: num_q_heads
free_parameters.why: query head count is not in the witness; two heads keeps the CPU eager path small and matches the witness q.shape[1]=2 head count

free_parameters.name: num_kv_heads
free_parameters.why: KV head count is not in the witness; equal to num_q_heads so no GQA grouping is exercised before the guard

free_parameters.name: gamma
free_parameters.why: attention coverage ratio is not in the witness; any value in (0,1) is valid and it only affects block selection, not the block-size guard

free_parameters.name: tau
free_parameters.why: query-aware threshold is not in the witness; 0 keeps the KL block-sparse branch off so the pre-target path is deterministic

free_parameters.name: seed
free_parameters.why: tensor seed is not in the witness; fixed so q/k/v are identical across fresh processes

mocks.reason: CPU-only machine: the real function launches the GPU-only bnhd_pool_kernel; only that launcher is replaced by an equivalent torch average pool over sequence blocks so the pre-target get_active_blocks can run

hooks.name: reset_causal_mask
hooks.purpose: clear the module-level causal_mask cache before each driver call so probe calls with different block sizes behave like fresh processes
